# Meriq

> Meriq is the AI operations engine for small and mid-sized Taiwanese freight forwarders (5–50 staff). It reads inquiry emails and shipping documents, drafts the quotation, fills the S/O, cross-checks CI / PL / HB/L / customs declarations against each other, and prepares bilingual (Chinese/English) reply drafts for customers and overseas agents. AI handles the semantic reading; every calculation and field mapping runs through deterministic, verifiable program logic — every number can answer "why is it this number." People only handle flagged exceptions. Nothing in the forwarder's existing systems has to be replaced: Meriq's output imports into whatever they already use. Built together with a Taiwanese customs brokerage team with 43 years of experience.

## What Meriq does
- Reads inquiry emails as-is (Chinese/English mixed, no formatting needed) and drafts the quotation: O/F, THC, DOC and other charges filled from the forwarder's own rate sheets, in minutes instead of half a day.
- Pulls S/O and shipping-instruction fields directly from the attached CI/PL.
- Cross-checks Commercial Invoice, Packing List, HB/L, and customs declaration data field by field (counts, weights, marks, consignee) and flags mismatches before anything is sent — not at customs.
- Drafts replies to customers and overseas agents in English and Chinese for the OP to review and send.
- Produces structured data ready to import into the forwarder's existing TMS or in-house system; queues pre-alerts.
- Flags what it isn't sure about; the OP confirms exceptions and sends. Everything else runs itself.

## Who it is for
Small and mid-sized Taiwanese freight forwarders (海空運承攬業, roughly 5–50 people). Users are OPs, documentation clerks, and sales assistants; buyers are owners and general managers. Customs brokers and carriers are partners, not competitors — Meriq does not file customs entries and is not a licensed forwarder.

## How it works
1. Drop it in: forward inquiry emails, CI/PL, SI, or rate sheets as-is.
2. Everything drafts itself: quotation draft, cross-document check report, bilingual reply drafts, structured data.
3. People only check exceptions: AI flags doubts, the OP confirms and sends.
